nestbound / game concept 03
THE GAME / AT A GLANCE

Grow together.
Survive as one.

Become a young dinosaur in a cooperative VR adventure. Explore a prehistoric world, find your community, and build a life together.

Cooperative VRRelaxing explorationMeaningful choices

The mission loop

01Receive→02Travel→03Decide→04Change your life
◒

EatGather fruit, hunt, or fish as your species allows.

⌂

BuildShape nests, shelters, crossings, and paths.

✧

FindDiscover land, friends, and a hidden haven.

A place to belong

Choose your species before starting alone. Make friends with players and AI, form a family, and protect eggs.

Choices become growth

Your actions develop abilities. Parents and habitat unlock traits to choose for future generations.

Gentle exploration, real stakes: storms can threaten your home. Loss can occur during active play; family needs pause while the household is offline.
